faqs.q: Can I buy from the Lux Store today?
faqs.a: The Store is live for browsing, comparing and saving items. Payment, final pricing and fulfillment remain disabled until those commercial systems are commissioned.

faqs.q: Does adding something to the bag charge me?
faqs.a: No. The current bag is a prelaunch saved-items list. It never collects payment information and does not place an order.

faqs.q: What does Lux Verify PASS mean on a Store item?
faqs.a: For new Kit Creator public releases, it means the required quality and verification fields and evidence passed the Store publishing gate. It is not a promise that every external service or future environment will behave identically.

faqs.q: Why do the older Prompt Kits say legacy approved listing?
faqs.a: They were already approved Store products before the newer contract-v2 publishing gate existed. They are not being relabeled as having passed a test they did not run.

faqs.q: How do I get help with an installed Lux product?
faqs.a: Use the Help & Legal or support area inside Lux Agent Desktop so guidance can match the edition and setup you are actually running.

faqs.q: Will devices have exact storage, speed and compatibility specs here?
faqs.a: Yes, but only after the customer SKU and fulfillment configuration are locked. The Store avoids inventing hardware specifications before that point.

faqs.q: How are new Prompt Kits published?
faqs.a: Lux Codex Kit Creator prepares the pack and its release assets. New public contract-v2 packs must clear the quality and Lux Verify publishing gate before the Store sync can publish them.

faqs.q: Is Lux Codex a customer product?
faqs.a: Lux Codex is the private founder control plane for operating the Lux business and Store. Customers use Lux Agent Desktop and the customer-facing Lux ecosystem.
